text: Oh man, I can tell just looking at you! You did it,\nright? You became a Champion?[VAR 0x0114(0004)]

text: C’mon, it’s me! You don’t have to lie! Just tell\nme—you became a Champion, right?![VAR 0x0114(0004)]

text: Which means we’re true equals! You and me,\nboth Champion-ranked Trainers! This is amazing![VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: champ_0270_rival_07
text: Now that you’ve made it here, I’ve got one thing\nto say.[VAR 0x0114(0004)]

text: Let’s you and me be best rivals for life![VAR 0x0114(0004)]

text: Sorry, not going to stop until I hear a yes—\nlet’s you and me be best rivals for life![VAR 0x0114(0004)]

text: I also must ask—is this roadside really the setting\nyou two want for your first battle as true equals\r\nand rivals?[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

label: champ_0270_rival_15
text: Hmm... Now that you mention it, that’s a\ngood point.[VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: champ_0270_rival_16
text: In that case, can we use one of the Pokémon\nLeague battle courts?[VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: champ_0270_chairman_05
text: Surely there’s somewhere more fitting. A place\nwith special meaning for the two of you, perhaps.[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

text: Special meaning, huh? Hmm... Let me see...\nAnywhere leap to mind, [VAR 0x0100(0000)]?[VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: champ_0270_rival_answer_a01
text: Haha! Our beach out back, huh? Yeah, the place\nwhere we had our first battle might work.[VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: champ_0270_rival_answer_a02
text: But on the other hand, to me it’s just kind of...\nmy backyard, y’know? A little ordinary.[VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: champ_0270_rival_answer_a03
text: Anyplace else come to mind?[VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: champ_0270_chairman_answer_c01
text: The Treasure Eatery? Is it significant to the two of\nyou somehow?[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

label: champ_0270_chairman_answer_c02
text: Ah, are you thinking of it ’cause it’s got the\nMedali Gym’s battle court?\c\nI guess it does bring back memories...of Larry...[VAR 0x0114(0004)]

text: Larry may not appreciate the surprise visit.\c\nIf you’ve any other suitable places in mind, would\nyou prioritize them instead, please?[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

text: Mesagoza? Oooh, good call! The place where we\nset out on our journey![VAR 0x0114(0004)]

text:
That reminds me, [VAR 0x0100(0000)]...\c
Remember back when Director Clavell explained

label: champ_0270_rival_20
text: Well, I know what treasure I got out of all this:\nI found a true rival—someone who can stand up\r\nto me at my full capabilities.[VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: champ_0270_rival_21
text: That’s right—I mean you! I’m so glad I got to\nmeet you, [VAR 0x0100(0000)]![VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: champ_0270_rival_22
text: Anyway, that being said...[VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: champ_0270_rival_23
text: I’ll be waiting for you at the battle court in\nMesagoza’s central plaza! See ya there![VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: champ_0270_chairman_06
text: The respect you two share is palpable. Even a bit\nenviable, to be honest.[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

label: champ_0270_chairman_07
text: I am known as La Primera—but even when facing\nme in the final test of her Champion Assessment,\r\nChampion Nemona didn’t reveal her full might.[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

label: champ_0270_chairman_08
text: In you, I suspect she has found someone she can\nbattle without holding anything back.[VAR 0x0114(0011)]
